newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures lower, pressured by firmer yen.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures lower, pressured by firmer yen.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures settled lower across the board in thin Monday trade, reflecting the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 1.7 yen per kilogram lower. Benchmark April settled 1.0 yen weaker at 142.2 yen.

After the market opened weaker on the stronger yen, prices drifted within limited ranges, the traders said. "The market is divided over near-term direction. The market is focusing on the amount of rubber submitted for certification for delivery against the November contract," one trader said.
